title: Why every company is building their own AI model in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Every company needs a custom AI to optimize for their unique data and business goals. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s a myth — off-the-shelf models like Llama 3 and Mistral are already powerful enough for most use cases. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But fine-tuning on proprietary data improves accuracy by up to 40%, as seen in finance and healthcare applications. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The cost and time to build a custom model far outweigh the benefits — 90% of companies don’t have the resources. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Not every company can or should build their own AI — that’s the real truth in 2026. (4 sec)
